operation.source_intent: For each authoritative site row in GlobalContentHub, expose navigation to the site workspace and that site's content explorer.

laravel_adaptation.authoritative_read: GET context.api.sites only after exact same-origin /api/tenants/{tenant}/sites validation
laravel_adaptation.explorer_adaptation_reason: Laravel's canonical Explorer route is site-bound through the validated site query instead of the ASP.NET /sites/{id}/explorer path.
laravel_adaptation.loading_empty_error: Explicit loading, empty, retryable error, and populated states; invalid or duplicate site identifiers are dropped rather than synthesized.

security_boundary.tenant_endpoint: Server-provided context.api.sites must exactly match the active encoded tenant path and same origin.
security_boundary.tenant_isolation: The sites API is behind auth + tenant.context and Site global tenant scope; foreign tenant requests return 404.
security_boundary.identity_input: Only server-returned positive integer site ids are accepted for destinations.

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and both source href fragments
authoritative tenant sites GET with no request body or mutation method
site details and Explorer destinations derived from active tenant plus returned site id
loading, empty, error, populated and retry states
invalid and duplicate identifiers fail closed
missing permission and non-authoritative endpoint fail closed
guest, foreign-tenant and tenant-scoped site read proof
